figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: An illustration of the evaluation pipeline. The pipeline consists of two steps: (1) Aspect Selection: First, appropriate aspects are selected from the TAs and UAs Trees based on task property and output modality. As illustrated, the question focuses on “cat image next to the orange dog picture”, while the image shows no cat adjacent to the orange dog. This discrepancy enables evaluation of the model’s ability to avoid hallucinations, specifically its performance on Context Inconsistency. Second, given the text output modality, aspects are selected from the Text Branch in the UAs Tree. (2) Evaluating: UFEval generates feedback and scores based on the input content and selected aspects.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 defines aspect selection and evaluation; Figure 2 establishes FRABench composition; Figures 3–5 and Tables 2–7 carry OOD, judge, multi-aspect and DPO claims; Figures 6–11 audit split balance/diversity; Figures 12–15 expand per-aspect and scale results; Figures 16–22 document human annotation reliability and aspect distinctness; Tables 58–75 expose prompts and qualitative successes/failures; Figure 36 closes the DPO image-generation story.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Captions consistently begin with Figure/Table label and title. Main result captions define split or metric but often state no denominator/uncertainty; appendix captions provide part numbers and pointer-like context. Figure 3 and 15 captions explain held-out encoding; Table 3 defines tau/diff; prompt and qualitative captions identify task/model provenance but not sampling.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Numeric tables use multi-level headers for task, benchmark, split and metric; best/second-best values use bold/underline and missing values use dashes. Taxonomy tables use stable aspect/definition/source columns. Prompt cards and qualitative comparison tables depart from numeric headers but preserve task/modality or evaluator provenance in the first row/column.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: The aspect-tree/pairwise-label interface in Figure 1 and Tables 13–23 feeds the FRABench split in Figure 2/Table 12, which is tested by the generalization radar/Table 2 and per-aspect Tables 33–48; Figure 5 and Tables 50–52 test joint learning; Tables 6–7 and Figure 36 test DPO use.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Main Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–7 state the resource, generalization, judge and downstream outcomes. Appendix Figures 6–22 and Tables 8–75 provide balance, aspect definitions, exact per-aspect values, prompts, reliability, correlations and selected qualitative cases; references to these objects are frequent but some captions require body text for denominators and exclusions.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Vector table/body typography is stable, but embedded raster figures have smaller sans-serif labels and dense appendix tables fall below comfortable reading size. UI/prompt screenshots are legible only with zoom, and taxonomy/heatmap abbreviations require cross-reference.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Color is categorical within each figure family rather than globally method-stable. Held-out black/blue sectors and diverging heatmap colors have local semantics; table ranking is grayscale-safe through bold/underline, whereas bars/radar methods remain color-dependent.

most_reusable_patterns: 将 aspect/task held-out 单元直接画入雷达 spoke 或黑/蓝 sector，并以 Table 2/29 的聚合行复核。
用固定多层表头和 bold/underline 规则把 benchmark、task、metric 与 split 保持可扫描对齐。
以 Figures 6–11 的组成/多样性诊断、Figures 16–18 的人类标注流程/IAA 和 Figures 19–22 的相关矩阵补足主结果的可审计边界。
将 prompt/interface 与 qualitative case 作为可复现机制证据，与 DPO 数值结果分开。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：把 UA/TA aspect selection、模态路由和 evaluator 输出压缩成方法接口。
Figure 3 + Table 2：同屏表达 task/aspect generalization 的 held-out 设计、聚合结果和黑色 unseen-TAs 语义。
Figure 4：暴露强、普遍差和弱 aspect，避免只报告平均准确率。
Tables 50–52、Figures 18–22：分别把联合学习异质性、人类可靠性和 aspect distinctness 的边界显式化。
failure_patterns: 多数 numeric/radar/bar 对象只给 point average，不给 seed、分母或运行/标注不确定性。
雷达和多组柱状图在缩小或灰度下依赖颜色，密集 appendix 标签和热图缩写降低可读性。
联合 task/aspect 配置同时改变数据范围与训练条件，视觉对象不能单独证明 synergy 的因果机制。
qualitative tables/Figure 36 是选择性案例，没有 prevalence 或 selection protocol，不能代替总体效果。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文先用 aspect-tree/FRABench 流程图定义统一评测接口，再用 held-out radar、分组表和 aspect bars 证明迁移与比较，最后用附录的组成、可靠性、相关性、prompt 和 qualitative 对象限定这些 point-estimate 结论的适用边界。
